title: What the Speaker Really Meant
goal: Report past indirect questions accurately and choose precise reporting verbs for hints, allusions and subtext.
grammar: indirect questions in the past and reporting verbs (insinuar, aludir)

items: I can report yes/no and open questions in the past with *si* and accented interrogative words.
I can use *insinuar que* and *aludir a* to report indirect or implicit meanings.
I can discuss insinuations, double meanings, alternative readings and subtext.
